header: Your first 30 days with Vertex Supply
subheadline: What onboarding actually looks like for a company of about fifty technicians, taken from the last twelve rollouts. Your implementation lead sets these dates in the kick-off call and then holds them.

items.title: Kick-off and data handover
items.description: A ninety-minute call to agree the rollout dates, followed by whatever asset and customer data you already have, in whatever shape it is in.

items.title: Your register, corrected
items.description: We return the imported sites, assets and contracts for review. Most companies find duplicate sites here that nobody had noticed in years.

items.title: First crew goes live
items.description: Four or five technicians run real calls on the app while the rest of the team continues as before. Their feedback shapes the checklists everyone else gets.

items.title: Whole team on the board
items.description: Dispatch switches on a Monday morning with your implementation lead on the line. Paper job sheets stay available for two more weeks, and then stop.
